messages.subject: Re: Problems installing rmr2
parts:
It appears to be a compatibility issue with  the latest Rcpp. Either downgrade Rcpp to 9.something or grab the latest rmr2 from the dev branch (assuming you have a little familiarity with how github works). I am sure this will be fixed in the next minor release. Thanks


Antonio
